paragraphs.source_en: When Ekei of Ankokuji heard that Hachisuka Hikoemon's son Iemasa had come as an envoy, he sensed something decidedly strange. It was already midnight, and Hachisuka's main camp on Mount Ishii lay ten li away; even at a gallop, it would be nearly dawn before Iemasa returned. Something extraordinary must have happened.

units.source_en: When Ekei of Ankokuji heard that Hachisuka Hikoemon's son Iemasa had come as an envoy, he sensed something decidedly strange.
units.source_zh: 安国寺的惠琼听说蜂须贺彦右卫门的儿子家政前来出使，感到事情非常蹊跷。

units.source_en: It was already midnight, and Hachisuka's main camp on Mount Ishii lay ten li away; even at a gallop, it would be nearly dawn before Iemasa returned. Something extraordinary must have happened.

paragraphs.source_zh: 安国寺的惠琼听说蜂须贺彦右卫门的儿子家政前来出使，感到事情非常蹊跷。已是深夜子时了，从这里到石井山上蜂须贺的大营有十里的路程，即使骑马飞奔而去，回大营也快天亮了，定有不寻常之事。

paragraphs.source_en: Ekei deliberately rose at a leisurely pace, washed his face, and went to receive the envoy. The envoy, Iemasa, was an old acquaintance, yet he wore an inexplicable expression. Once they had exchanged greetings, Iemasa produced a letter.

units.source_en: Ekei deliberately rose at a leisurely pace, washed his face, and went to receive the envoy.

paragraphs.source_en: Ekei slowly rolled up the letter. He was about to say, “I shall call on you tomorrow morning,” but stopped himself. It was not Hideyoshi who now faced hardship, but the Mōri.

units.source_en: It was not Hideyoshi who now faced hardship, but the Mōri.

paragraphs.source_en: Of the three injunctions handed down in the Mōri house precepts, one declared, “When high and low are of one heart, their strength can cut through metal.” One might say that Hideyoshi's side now held complete victory in its hands. Bound by that precept to rescue Shimizu Muneharu and his five thousand officers and men from the flooded castle, the Mōri side was trapped in a hopelessly unfavorable position.
